subject: Next steps & procurement timeline for Orion Health
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@orionhealth.com>, Devon Shaw <devon.shaw@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 14:03:00 -0400
Subject: Recap + proposed procurement timeline (legal -> security -> finance -> PO)

Hi Aisha / Devon — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has visibility.

TL;DR — Orion appears to prefer a PO-based flow (finance-led). We outlined: legal review -> security questionnaire -> finance approval -> PO issuance. Below is a suggested mutual action plan (MAP) and timeline for alignment. Please confirm stakeholders and any internal calendar constraints.

High-level MAP (proposed):
- Week 1 (May 5–11): Legal review of our terms (redlines to be tracked in DocuSign/Google doc)
- Week 2–3 (May 12–25): Security review — vendor questionnaire + SOC 2 evidence
- Week 4 (May 26–Jun 1): Finance approval & PO generation
- Target PO issuance: by Jun 3 (allows vendor setup and kickoff)

Questions / asks for you:
1) Confirm primary procurement owner (name & email) we should schedule the legal review with.
2) Do you prefer we provide a completed vendor questionnaire or your security team will use their standard form?
3) Marketplace option: do you want us to also provide pricing for marketplace procurement or keep it out for now?

Attachments: RDW_MAP_Orion_v1.pdf (draft MAP), purchase-path-form.pdf (short vendor info sheet).

If helpful, Ben and Marissa can join a one-hour procurement sync to run through legal and security dependencies. Happy to schedule for Tue/Wed next week.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Exec, Commercial
Redwood Inference
--
Attachment stubs: RDW_MAP_Orion_v1.pdf (10 pages), purchase-path-form.pdf (1 page)

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@orionhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Shaw <devon.shaw@orionhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:46:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed procurement timeline (legal -> security -> finance -> PO)

Thanks Hannah — helpful note and appreciated.

Couple quick data points from our side:
- Procurement lead is Devon Shaw (copied) — finance will own PO issuance.
- We typically do PO when annual spend > $50k. This deal will likely cross that threshold and PO is our default.
- Security will want our standard vendor questionnaire completed plus SOC 2 Type II. If you can share the SOC2 summary and a filled questionnaire that speeds things up.
- Marketplace procurement is currently not top of mind (we use marketplace for small third-party tools); for platform vendors we usually do direct PO.

We have an internal blackout week May 17–21 (quarterly close) — that will push any finance approval that lands during that week out by one week.

I’ll set up a 30-min procurement intro with Devon and include our legal lead (Michael Lee). Proposed time: Thu May 6, 10am ET.

Thanks — I’ll review your MAP and get back with confirmed attendees.

—Aisha
Head of IT Procurement
Orion Health
--
Attachment stubs: none

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@orionhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 11:12:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Recap + proposed procurement timeline (legal -> security -> finance -> PO)

Good context from Aisha — a few internal notes and suggestions before we send the MAP back:
- Pricing: we should pre-author a 60-day PO pricing hold in the MAP to reduce friction once finance is ready.
- Legal: push for limited redlines only; mark any non-starters in the doc so legal can triage quickly.
- Security: I can attach a one-pager SOC2-summary.pdf that lists our controls and the auditor report meta; this usually moves security reviews faster.
- Marketplace: since Orion prefers direct PO, prioritize PO vs. card path; still include a short appendix with marketplace SKUs in case they change procurement later.

I’ll add shelf pricing language and the SOC2 one-pager to the MAP draft. Hannah — if you can nudge for the procurement intro on Thu we should capture the procurement timeline and get Devon to commit to a kickoff date.

Ben Carter
Senior Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
--
Attachment stubs: SOC2-summary.pdf (3 pages)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@orionhealth.com>, Devon Shaw <devon.shaw@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 08:07:00 -04:00
Subject: MAP v1 (updated) + proposed procurement kickoff

Aisha / Devon — attaching MAP v1 with Ben’s edits and SOC2 summary. I also added a short appendix with marketplace SKUs per Ben’s suggestion. Key changes are: 60-day pricing hold, a legal triage page (redlines flagged), and pre-populated answers to the common vendor questionnaire.

Proposed meeting: Procurement intro + MAP walk-through
- When: Thu May 6, 10:00–10:30 AM ET
- Attendees suggested: Devon (procurement), Michael Lee (legal), Aisha (procurement), Hannah, Ben, Marissa

Updated timeline (calendar-aware):
- May 5–11: Legal review (we expect redlines; please capture in the shared doc)
- May 12–26: Security review (we will provide completed questionnaire + SOC2 artifacts immediately after kickoff)
- May 27–Jun 2: Finance approval (note Orion blackout May 17–21 pushes any in-flight approvals one week later)
- Target PO issuance: Jun 3–10 (contingent on legal & security)

DocuSign/Redlines: I’ll put a copy of our standard MSA in DocuSign and share the link during the call.

Links & attachments:
- RDW_MAP_Orion_v1.pdf (attached)
- SOC2-summary.pdf (attached)
- DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/rdw/placeholder
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/5472

If the 10am ET slot on Thu works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Hannah
Account Exec, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: RDW_MAP_Orion_v2.pdf (11 pages), SOC2-summary.pdf (3 pages), purchase-path-form.pdf (1 page)

From: Devon Shaw <devon.shaw@orionhealth.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:21:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MAP v1 (updated) + proposed procurement kickoff

Hannah — thanks for the update and the MAP. Thu May 6 10:00 AM ET works for me and I’ll bring our finance contact (Michael Lee will be on the legal side).

We’ll start legal review on May 5 and aim to have initial comments back by May 11. Security team will kick off the questionnaire immediately after the kickoff call — expect their window to be May 12–26. Given our blackout week May 17–21, finance will likely complete approvals the week of May 24 and generate the PO by ~May 31–Jun 3. That aligns with your target range.

I uploaded our internal procurement form after the call — attached: procurement_form_filled.pdf.

Devon Shaw
Procurement Lead
Orion Health
